cui_equivalent: Shares a UMLS CUI; same number of CUIs
cui_narrowing: Shares a CUI; added code has fewer CUIs
cui_mild: Shares a CUI; added code has more CUIs (< 4)
cui_broad: Shares a CUI; added code has ≥ 4 CUIs
hier_consensus: UMLS child asserted by ≥ k source families
hier_other: UMLS child from another source vocabulary
